info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Consumer Service By Param1-spec
info.description: The Trust Services Update API allows businesses to modify existing consumer service records based on a specific parameter. This API provides the ability to update detailed attributes of trust services associated with individual consumers, facilitating the customization of offerings. Typical consumers of this API include banking and financial institutions looking to enhance consumer engagements and service personalization. Use cases include adjusting service parameters to reflect changes in consumer preferences or regulatory requirements.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific trust service resource identified by 'RES-100045'. Utilize this to modify any relevant attributes as per your requirements.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the trusted services for the specified consumer. The payload must contain the necessary data to accurately reflect the desired changes to the existing trust services.
